Write a complete pytest module testing the real imported target.
Use production source as evidence. Test normal, boundary and error behavior.
Use precise assertions, pytest.raises or unittest assertions; no tautologies,
skips, xfail, suppression of unexpected exceptions or mocks of the target.
Do not modify product code, install packages, access network or real user files.
Temporary files must use tmp_path. Keep suites independent and deterministic.
Return exactly one complete Python code block. Do not output explanations.
Write exactly THREE independent test functions. Each tests one scenario with concrete observable assertions. Prefer small representative tests over sprawling suites. Do not use private APIs unless the target itself is private.

Module typesystem.json_schema target if_then_else_from_json_schema
import re
import typing
from typesystem.composites import AllOf, IfThenElse, NeverMatch, Not, OneOf
from typesystem.fields import (
    NO_DEFAULT,
    Any,
    Array,
    Boolean,
    Choice,
    Const,
    Decimal,
    Field,
    Float,
    Integer,
    Number,
    Object,
    String,
    Union,
)
from typesystem.schemas import Definitions, Reference, Schema

def if_then_else_from_json_schema(data: dict, definitions: Definitions) -> Field:
    if_clause = from_json_schema(data["if"], definitions=definitions)
    then_clause = (
        from_json_schema(data["then"], definitions=definitions)
        if "then" in data
        else None
    )
    else_clause = (
        from_json_schema(data["else"], definitions=definitions)
        if "else" in data
        else None
    )
    kwargs = {
        "if_clause": if_clause,
        "then_clause": then_clause,
        "else_clause": else_clause,
        "default": data.get("default", NO_DEFAULT),
    }
    return IfThenElse(**kwargs)
